content.short: Orniton is a TON wallet experience for storing, sending, and interacting with Toncoin and TON assets.
content.description: Orniton is listed as a wallet-style app in the TON ecosystem. Its role is to help users manage Toncoin and related assets, sign actions, and access everyday wallet workflows without acting as an exchange or analytics tool. Orniton is a cryptocurrency wallet designed specifically for NFT enthusiasts to empower the growing NFT ecosystem and everyday users with functionality they never have. The product surface includes earn, manage and sell crypto, nft on ton and orniton. Orniton fills a practical wallet role because users need safe account access before using TON apps, payments, swaps, or collectibles.
